name: SilverVale: Daily Commute
source:
You are on your daily commute to the heart of SilverVale, a bustling city that is ruled by an empire of rabbit like aliens known as the Mochibuns. The story takes places hundreds of years after these aliens invade your home planet of Eris. While waiting for the train, you run into an arctic fox/grey wolf hybrid named Nera. She offers a variety of kinky acts to pass the time as you ride the mag train to work.

[From [url=https://nerashiva.itch.io/silvervale-daily-commute]Itch.io[/url]]
